title: Chapter 470
paragraphs: Chapter 470
Episode 132. Massacre, and something strange... (4)
Huuuung...!
It was as if black ink was spreading in a transparent container; the energy that escaped from Murakan began to dye the sky.
The speed was incredibly fast. In an instant, the night became dark without a trace of moonlight, and Murakan's amber-colored eyes became more prominent.
They looked like the eyes of a grim reaper, especially to those who looked up at Murakan under the darkened sky.
-Once I say I'll sweep them all away, start using all the phrases after number 100 harmoniously.
-Phrases after number 100? Those are all about death and destruction.
-Exactly. While using those phrases appropriately, the message should be to really kill them all, leaving only about five insignificant characters in each faction.

-Heh, kid. You seem to be mistaken. I don't need to be told or decide on such things. I can do it well on my own. Your phrases seem to be used by pretentious people who just add unnecessary weight. Real veterans like me give fear more simply.
-I know, but we need some bluffs.
-What, bluffs?

-You're not as strong as you were during your heyday, yet. Let's try to look as impressive as possible until you regain all your strength. You know your reputation skyrocketed after the Heukwangdan incident, right?

-Tsk, I don't like it. Anyway, I'll follow your advice. I am Murakan, the worst nightmare a mortal can experience, and you will become the deceased who can never dream again. How did you choose such a cringeworthy phrase?
-Was it number 107? Why, it doesn't seem that bad. Anyway, when killing enemies, use techniques that look as impressive as possible, even if they're inefficient but cool and majestic.
-I got it, I got it.
The conversation they had while preparing the phrases.
Although he said he didn't like it, in fact, Murakan secretly felt satisfaction from the increase in his reputation after the Heukwangdan incident.

Of course, compared to the grandeur of his heyday, it was nothing more than a drop in the bucket. But when people who didn't know him treated him like an ordinary dragon, he couldn't help but feel a sense of diminished pride (although there were hardly any such instances).
In other words, the opportunity to further increase his satisfaction had arrived.
[I am Murakan.]
Whirlwinds began to form all over the pitch-black sky.
In an instant, hundreds of whirlwinds appeared, and from the center of each, a dark and massive spike emerged.
These were the black spikes that would ravage the earth at Murakan's will.
[The worst nightmare a mortal can experience.]
His solemn and chilling voice weighed heavily on the entire area. The gloomy vibrations echoed in all directions, causing the island's creatures and insects to hastily hide.
Birds flew away from the island, while beasts and insects burrowed into deep holes.
He had regained 50% of his power.
The movements of all the lesser creatures seemed to be conveyed one by one.

The sound of a flock of birds flapping their wings as they took flight, the sensation of frogs hiding and kicking the dirt with their front legs, and the running and flying of insects burrowing deeper into the forest.
Murakan felt all of this while floating in the sky.
He savored it.
A thousand years ago, these sensations often replaced music or the appreciation of spring paintings. He had completely forgotten them until he recovered 50% of his power.
So he waited quietly for a while.
So that the lesser creatures could escape sufficiently. He also checked the locations of the creatures that couldn't avoid it. He tried to be careful not to let them die when the slaughter began.
With the movements of the lesser creatures coming so vividly,
It was impossible not to feel the fear of the humans lying right below.
'Just by deploying my power, this kind of pressure... No wonder the royal dragons were afraid.'
'He said he had a damaged heart, but is this really the power of a damaged state? Has it all recovered?'
'Scary, so scary, please save me!'
The people of the Royal Family, Zipple, and Kinsello's beastmen each thought.
Their heartbeats and tremors sounded like pleasant melodies.
'Yes, that's the feeling. The feeling that I can kill and bring back everything at my will!'
His tail stiffened and his chest trembled with the thrilling sensation he felt for the first time in a thousand years.
Although he would not be able to enjoy this feeling against the world's top fighters, for now, he was no different from being the god of this military road.
While all the real enemies were extremely tense without a word,
Only one person, Sandra Zipple, kept cursing.

"Midorel Elnor, you ungrateful bastard! I'm warning you in advance, try activating the wand of Matop without my permission. Huh? I'll personally slice your neck with a scimitar and display it in the middle of Drakka Square."
She seemed to have no interest in her severed arm.
The cut surface was somewhat healed, and the bleeding had been stopped with ordinary healing magic rather than the power of time.
Not only did she continue to curse Midorel, but she also spoke softly to Jin with an infinitely gentle voice.
"Our date had some problems because of a bastard who is not even worth being fed to wild dogs. You'll understand generously with a heart as handsome as your face, right?"
It's probably best not to get involved with this human.
Such an instinctive signal was ringing wildly in Jin's brain.
It was not just a chilling sensation in the back of his waist, but a strange kind of fear that made goosebumps run all over his body for the first time.
"Anyway, where were we in the story?"
"Well, um. The Mashin Stone."
"Ah, that's right. The Mashin Stone. We had such a hard time creating it without Kinsello..."
"Sandra! No, you crazy person! Stop it already...!"
As Sandra was about to cause another uproar following Midorel's desperate cry, Murakan realized that the lesser creatures had either all left or settled in their places.
[You will all become the dead, never to dream again.]
Murakan finished his 107th remark.
Then, he scanned the ground with satisfied eyes. He had determined the locations where the needles would fall.
From the whirlwind of energy, a dark, sharp rain began to fall.
Each whirlwind continuously spat out one giant needle and hundreds of smaller needles that formed nearby.
From a distance, it looked as if a swarm of locusts had suddenly covered the military road.
What was even scarier was that the needles were falling without making any sound. 'Silence' was one of the most superior attributes of the power of shadow and energy.
"Stop it!"
"Damn it, save Sandra!"
"Arrrgghh!"
Despite the pouring needles, all that could be heard were screams and the noise of things being destroyed.
Usually, when using magic or skills of this scale, some friendly casualties are expected.
However, the needles of energy didn't fall on the Rune Candle Knights at all.
They fell while maintaining a distance of less than a foot. It seemed as if only the Rune Candle's camp had an umbrella over it.
Naturally.
The gazes of the Rune Candles could only be directed towards Jin and Murakan.
Especially towards Jin. In some ways, Jin, who was watching the enemies being killed with a numb expression, seemed even more brutal than Murakan, who was pouring needles.
As Rune Candles, they felt as if they had glimpsed a hierarchical relationship.

'The youngest one commands like that, and he acts without showing any discomfort? Although the relationship between a guardian dragon and its contractor usually puts the former in a somewhat subordinate position, this is completely like a master and a servant!'
Beyond just piercing and penetrating, Murakan's needles were literally 'grinding' the enemies.
Could he keep up with Murakan even if he combined all his affiliated guardian knights and execution knights?
He was certain he could not.
'My guardian knights can't even compare, and maybe even my older brother's forces...'
He might not be able to handle Murakan.
Suddenly, that thought crossed his mind.
Buego was truly taken aback by the overwhelming power and spectacle he hadn't seen in a long time. And that misconception would become a significant rumor after he returned to the Sword Garden.
Sandra was also being torn to shreds.
"Uh, please, think, ugh, about, marrying, me."
Surprisingly, and as she had been doing all this time, she continued to regenerate her body and fixed her gaze on Jin.
"Argh!"
"Ugh!"

The elders who rushed to save her left their last screams as they cast their protective shields. Although Midorel's command meant they had to save her, in reality, the power of the elders was insufficient.
Midorel knew this fact.
He gave the order only because he didn't know what problems would arise later if he didn't take any action while pureblood was being torn apart in front of him.
Moreover, he needed to establish a justification.
There had been many sacrifices to save Sandra, but in the end, she couldn't escape the state where she was unable to carry out the tactical command.
So, he had no choice but to take full command and authority in her place.
"7th Tower Master, this should be enough. Now, even the Tower Master and the Elders' Council will understand if you take command...!"
"If it continues like this, it will be a massacre. Sandra's regeneration is not infinite, you know. To save her... we have to use that method!"
An elder, looking at the needle that had penetrated the protective shield, spoke.
Midorel, as if he had no choice, clenched his lips and nodded.

-Judging by the disappearance of the giant figure, it is highly likely that the mercenary Amella has already been defeated by Murakan! 7th Tower Master, I understand your desire to avenge the previous Tower Master, but we must retreat now!
-7th Tower Master!
-Activate it!
That method.
That was the reason Midorel Elnar had not retreated despite witnessing the collaborative work of Murakan and Jin in a moment of crisis from the beginning.
"Hoo."
Midorel took a deep breath. It was to hide his rough breath, filled with excitement about finally being able to take his revenge.
It was rather fortunate. If Sandra had just asked to retreat, he would have had to withdraw without any resistance, with the enemy right in front of him.
"I understand."
Midorel spoke, taking something out from his pocket.
